settingsContract.shape: { sensitiveFields: string[], rules: { id, pattern, flags? }[], exceptions: { ruleId, value }[], piiEntities: string[] }
settingsContract.validation: validateSettings() requires a plain object, runs normalizeRedactionConfig(), and throws GuardError('INVALID_SETTINGS', 'Invalid redaction: <key>[<index>]: <message>') for any issue; unknown nested keys are issues; messages never contain a pattern, exception value, or RegExp parser text
settingsContract.stored: validated settings carry the normalized config, so files saved by this version contain all four lists
settingsContract.inputType: GuardSettingsInput (Partial<Omit<GuardSettings, 'redaction'>> & { redaction?: RedactionConfig }) for GuardOptions.settings and ApprovalSettingsStore defaults, matching validation that fills omitted lists
settingsContract.redactorLifetime: reviewRedactor(config) caches one redactor per immutable settings value; GuardController.reviewRedactor reads the current settings, so changes apply to evidence added afterwards

hostRules.structuralLegacy: non-string values under keys matching ^(authorization|api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)$ become "[REDACTED]" before the engine runs, as 0.3.0 did, and are reported as field.sensitive locations
hostRules.legacySample: 'token=private password=secret Bearer abcdef SYNTHETIC_SECRET_MARKER sk-12345678' keeps none of the raw values

identifierPositions.contextItemContent: top-level toolCallId, callIdentity, parentToolCallId, parentCallIdentity, actionDigest, stage, tool, role, isError, and result.{actionDigest, contextDigest, policyDigest}

request.context: sessionId, contextId, turnId, digest; items[i].{id, source, trust, isTruncated}; items[i].content as above
request.untrustedAction: schemaVersion, toolCallId, tool, source, sessionId, policyRevision, permissionDigest, digest (args and cwd are scanned)

identifierPositions.neverByName: keys inside args, tool output, and text content are scanned regardless of their names
identifierPositions.evidence: [context-binding] identifier-shaped PII leaves session, call, item and digest identifiers unchanged (piiEntities: ['UUID'])

requestMasking.removed: the 'Exact action contains credential material that cannot enter the reviewer prompt' refusal
requestMasking.masked: context, untrustedAction, requestedPermissionDelta, policyReason, executionContext, and approvalRequest pass redactReviewData() as one JSON value; each string is scanned whole
requestMasking.redactedActionFields: [{ path: (string|number)[], ruleId }] relative to the action, present only when the action copy changed
requestMasking.binding: actionDigest, contextDigest, and policyDigest still use the original action, context, and policy; the action object is never modified
requestMasking.budget: reviewContextChars still checks the masked request.data; redactedActionFields adds about 60 characters per masked field, and an overflow fails closed as before

policyDigestChange.paragraph: The controller masks credentials, private keys, configured sensitive values and enabled personal data before review. ... Do not assume withheld text is harmless or harmful; judge the action from its visible structure and effects.
policyDigestChange.check: the 'before' value equals both the main checkout build and the new text without the paragraph
policyDigestChange.consumers: recorded in ReviewResult only; stored results with the 0.3.0 digest still load as evidence

downgradeLimit: Settings saved by this version contain redaction; 0.3.0 and earlier reject the file with 'Unknown setting: redaction'. Remove the key before downgrading (docs/usage.md, docs/usage.ko.md).

persistence.currentEntries: AUTHORIZATION_ENTRY text and REVIEW_CONTEXT_ENTRY items written by this version reload unchanged, and re-authorizing the same masked text does not change scopeVersion
persistence.legacyEntries: 0.3.0 masked text 'token=[REDACTED] password=[REDACTED] Bearer [REDACTED] [REDACTED]' reloads unchanged; no one-time authorizationVersion bump was observed for it
persistence.olderUnmaskedText: authorization text stored unmasked before 0.3.0 would be masked on reload and count as a changed authorization once; not exercised

dependency.checkPackage: scripts/check-package.mjs asserts the dependency equals the workspace @buyong/redact version and that nothing is bundled
dependency.probes: test/e2e/guard.test.mjs and test/docker/package.mjs pack @buyong/redact and extract it into the consumer's node_modules/@buyong/redact; the e2e probe prints factoryLoaded:true
dependency.releaseOrder: publish @buyong/redact 0.1.0 directly first, connect its Trusted Publisher, then release @buyong/pi-codex-auto-review (docs/publishing.md, docs/publishing.ko.md)

documents: docs/usage.md / docs/usage.ko.md: redaction settings row and Reviewer redaction section
docs/publishing.md / docs/publishing.ko.md: release order and the @buyong/redact Actions test step

added: [settings] reviewer redaction settings default to empty lists and reject entries without echoing values
[review] credential-bearing exact actions reach the reviewer masked and stay bound to the original
[review] a token in the command, a PEM block, a sensitive assignment and an opted-in e-mail address are masked for the reviewer
[context-binding] identifier-shaped PII leaves session, call, item and digest identifiers unchanged
[review] settings rules, exceptions and the 0.3.0 reviewer patterns mask reviewer data
[review-context] masked evidence written by this version and 0.3.0 masked text reload unchanged

testCounts.node22: test/unit/reviewer.test.mjs and test/unit/policy.test.mjs pass on Node 22.19.0

verifyDocker.image: builds @buyong/redact then @buyong/pi-codex-auto-review; test/docker/package.mjs installs both packed artifacts into the consumer
verifyDocker.earlierAttempt: a run at 05:09 failed because the image lacked packages/redact NOTICE and the old data/pii path, and sources changed during the run; both causes were fixed before this run

sideEffects.auditAndUi: redact() in audit.ts and its audit, /approvals, notification, and lifecycle callers are unchanged
sideEffects.digests: actionDigest, contextDigest, permissionDigest, and policyDigest computation and comparison are unchanged
sideEffects.redactPackage: packages/redact/** is unchanged by this child
sideEffects.exports: package exports '.' and './startup' and the CLI are unchanged
sideEffects.ciBuild: npm run build (turbo, dependsOn ^build) builds @buyong/redact before @buyong/pi-codex-auto-review; npm-package.yml's --filter build includes the dependency
